title: To name the Department of Veterans Affairs community-based outpatient clinic in The Dalles, Oregon, as the "Loren R. Kaufman VA Clinic".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was passed by the House on May 23, 2016. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

The Department of Veterans Affairs community-based outpatient clinic located at 704 Veterans Drive, The Dalles, Oregon, shall be designated as the "Loren R. Kaufman VA Clinic."

summary.headline: A 2016 law renamed the VA outpatient clinic in The Dalles, Oregon, as the Loren R. Kaufman VA Clinic.
summary.what_it_does: The law officially names the Department of Veterans Affairs community-based outpatient clinic at 704 Veterans Drive in The Dalles, Oregon, as the Loren R. Kaufman VA Clinic. It changes only the clinic's name and does not change its services, staffing, or funding.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on June 22, 2016.
